svg.title: SGLang and vLLM serving our model
svg.desc: Stock SGLang 0.5.23 agrees with our model on 68.5% of top-1 tokens and with the model without its router bias on 96.0%; vLLM 0.33.0 agrees on 93.4%. The upstream fix raises routing agreement on ERNIE-4.5-21B from 67.5% to 94.3%.
svg.text: SGLang drops our router’s selection bias. vLLM keeps it.
Our ERNIE export at the dry-run-2 shape (8 layers, 16 experts, top-2), random weights · SGLang 0.5.23 and vLLM 0.33.0 · one L4 · bf16
